unit.title: Build a Testable 2D Transform Pipeline
unit.scope: A bounded kickoff connecting linear-algebraic graphics transformations to maintainable C++ software, deterministic command-line behavior, and independent tests.
prerequisites: Linear algebra: vectors and matrix multiplication
Basic command-line build and test workflow
learning_objectives: Represent translation, scaling, and rotation with homogeneous 3-by-3 matrices using an explicit convention.
Implement ordered transform composition and explain why the order is observable.
Separate mathematical operations, parsing, validation, and presentation behind testable interfaces.
Define deterministic success and failure behavior for a small C++ command-line tool.
Produce unit, composition, property, and malformed-input tests and interpret their evidence honestly.
required_outputs: A CMake-based C++17 source tree implementing the specified transform2d program
README.md with reproducible build and test commands
DESIGN.md with conventions, invariants, complexity, error behavior, and one documented tradeoff
COMPREHENSION_RESPONSES.md containing the learner's own responses

completion_policy.unit_completion_rule: All required outputs must exist and an independent validator must verify the build, automated tests, public command-line contract, design evidence, and comprehension responses.
required_evidence: CTest results from the built submission
Independent black-box checks of transform order and malformed-input behavior
Inspection of source boundaries, learner-authored tests, DESIGN.md, and COMPREHENSION_RESPONSES.md
completion_policy.whole_course_completion_rule: Not defined by this kickoff. Later jobs must retrieve and classify additional material, prepare additional units, and validate each unit before whole-course completion can be considered.
